title: Add campus selection to onboarding
text:
Right now the app assumes everyone is at Westbrook. Before Lakeside we need a "Which school are you at?" step, without making onboarding longer again (Priya just cut it from 7 screens to 4).

*   Priya: put the school picker on the same screen as the course picker
*   Sam: detect the school from the .edu email domain when possible, so most people never see the picker
